I got the base of this recipe from: http://hubpages.com/food/spicypickledeggs and modified it for taste and preference.

  • 18 Eggs
  • 4 Cups White Vinegar
  • 1 Cup Water
  • 1 Cup White Sugar
  • 2 Teaspoon Salt
  • 2 Teaspoon Pickling Spice
  • 2 Teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper
  • 2 Teaspoon Ground Red Pepper
  • 2 Pablano Peppers (Sliced w/seed)
  • 2 Jalapenos (Sliced w/seed)
  • 2 Teaspoon Ancho Chili Pepper

Simmer all ingredients 15min, if u can ventilate the kitchen do so (you are warned). I used old 1gal. pickle jar, put 4 eggs in bottom then ladled pickle mix, layer as you go. Put the lid on, let cool and place in fridge. Give your eggs a few weeks before devouring.

My recipe differs in that they will be spicy from the pickling spice & jalapeno. The flavor will come from the pablano & Ancho chile pepper. If you can find pablano roasted and dried in the intl. aisle of your grocer I would go with that. A good smokey/spicy pickled egg.
